acceptanceCriteria: A RED test on restored baseline proves the exact separating runway recovery contact anchors instead of retaining a pending virtual pose.
A test-only fixed-step trace records every second-pose set, consume, expiry, reset, terminal, non-runway, and inactive-support clear with age and reason.
The trace proves whether expiry is the cause before any TTL change is accepted; an unproven expiry hypothesis fails the attempt.
When the second pose is created, it remains pending through at least the measured 2.10 second hold until the scheduled second release tap.
The second release consumes the pending pose exactly once and starts from x≈332.7, y≈469.71, angle≈6.65657 before velocity is applied.
The first release still matches x≈305.2, y≈514.17, angle≈4.98628 and remains visibly airborne before its tap.
The candidate's pose lifetime is bounded and documented; no unbounded latch or global magic velocity clamp is allowed.
Reset/loadLevel, terminal, expiry beyond the documented bound, non-runway contact, and inactive-support cancellation remain covered.
Non-runway support anchors, opening white landing, side sharp contact, approaching top contact, and blunt bounce remain unchanged.
The same seed-31 fixed timestamp replay reaches at least 11.9 seconds and x>2000 without failure or authored-support stall.
Only game-core.ts and level1-recovery.test.ts change; no renderer, level, platform, shared factory, or release files.
pnpm test, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck pass and exactly one pnpm build succeeds with a recorded dist SHA-256.
Independent fresh natural QA must retest both viewports, exact runway branch, visible terminal/settlement, and replay; no Fixer runtime claim.
